PROJECT.md · README.md
Open with the distinction between generation and confidence. Literate AI makes readable intent durable and requires generated implementation to earn acceptance.
LITERATE-AICONFERENCE 202602

THE BOTTLENECK MOVED

Code generation made code abundant. Confidence stayed scarce.

PROMPTplausible intent
→
SOURCEplausible implementation
→
TESTSplausible self-assessment
→
?release confidence

A candidate can be coherent, tested, and still be wrong about the authority it was meant to implement.

source-notes.md
Do not frame models as the problem. The missing piece is an independently checkable custody and acceptance boundary.
LITERATE-AICONFERENCE 202603

THREE THINGS MUST REMAIN DIFFERENT

Invert the product: intent is durable; implementation is renewable.

AUTHORITY

INTENT

Readable behavior
and constraints

CANDIDATE

IMPLEMENTATION

Replaceable source
and native artifacts

ADMISSION

and current receipts

source-notes.md
This is the core thesis. A model can help regenerate implementation, but cannot grant itself authority or acceptance.
LITERATE-AICONFERENCE 202604

COMPOSITION WITHOUT COPY-AND-PASTE

A Component DAG keeps authority factored—and still makes art.

Componentmathphysics3Dmusicvideo

Each node owns a readable boundary. Edges express composition, not copy-and-paste.

source-notes.md
The DAG is both a technical boundary and a creative palette. Components can be small enough to review and rich enough to collaborate.
LITERATE-AICONFERENCE 202605

EVERY TRANSITION CAN REFUSE

The lifecycle is a chain of custody, not a single generate button.

RESOLVEexact DAG
GENERATEbounded context
BUILDnative tools
VERIFYindependent oracle
RECEIPTcurrent evidence
RELEASEexact commit

A changed specification, Flavor, skill, route, dependency, toolchain, or artifact changes what must be proved.

source-notes.md
The exact recipe is broader than source. Reuse is allowed only when the relevant identities remain current.

LITERATE-AICONFERENCE 202609

SIDE EFFECTS CHANGE RETRY POLICY

Failure is evidence, too—if ownership stays explicit.

MODEL OUTPUT

Useful proposal
No acceptance authority

FAILED ATTEMPT

Retain diagnostics
Preserve ownership uncertainty

TRUSTED RESOLUTION

Owned terminal evidence
or admitted fenced lease

Retry policy must follow side effects—not optimism.

source-notes.md
This is why the action DAG distinguishes immutable production from mutable package or signing operations.

YES, IT HAS A PIPE ORGAN · NO, FINANCE DID NOT ASK FOR IT

The cathedral is the argument: rigor can wear better clothes.

READABLE

Select a node and inspect the authority it owns.

REPLACEABLE

PROVABLE
